command.description: A curl command line, as copied from a terminal, browser devtools or API documentation. Line continuations and $'...' quoting are understood. Nothing is executed or expanded.

importResult.description: What an importer produced. It is a draft: nothing is written to disk.

warnings.description: Everything the source expressed that a request cannot: file bodies, proxies, client certificates, unsupported auth schemes, unknown options, shell variables left as written. Omitted when empty.

root.description: The workspace root. The shell injects it; the renderer cannot choose it.

content.description: The text of a Postman collection (v2.0 or v2.1), an Insomnia v4 export (both JSON) or an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 document (JSON or YAML). The format is detected from the content.

collections.description: One per collection created. An Insomnia export with several workspaces yields several.

path.description: The new folder, relative to the workspace root. Never an existing one.

warnings.description: Everything the source expressed that a request cannot. Omitted when empty.

secrets.description: Credentials lifted out of the written files, which now refer to them as {{name}}. The shell stores them in safeStorage and strips this field before anything reaches the renderer. Omitted when empty.
